name: sol_integrations_lsd_reth_5
description: Hardcoded or stale ETH/rETH conversion rate ignoring accruing staking rewards
question: The source file in `source` contains code that converts between ETH and rETH amounts using a fixed or hardcoded exchange rate (such as a 1:1 ratio or a constant stored at deployment) instead of querying RocketPool's live exchange-rate mechanism (e.g. getExchangeRate, getEthValue, getRethValue), so the conversion becomes inaccurate as staking rewards accrue over time, causing mispriced deposits, withdrawals, or collateral valuations; this excludes code that calls RocketPool's current rate/oracle functions on each conversion or otherwise dynamically updates the rate to reflect accrued rewards.
criteria: A function computes rETH-to-ETH or ETH-to-rETH value by multiplying/dividing with a constant ratio defined in the contract instead of calling the RocketPool exchange rate contract
Conversion logic assumes rETH and ETH are always equivalent 1:1 and never adjusts for staking reward accrual
A cached exchange rate value is stored once at initialization and reused for all later conversions without refreshing from RocketPool
Deposit or withdrawal accounting uses a locally tracked conversion rate updated only manually/off-chain rather than fetching RocketPool's live getExchangeRate() or equivalent
